title: Pre-render replay page metadata in Astro instead of mutating the DOM after load
description:
Static replay pages are still withholding useful metadata until the client fetch completes and `init-game-replay.js` patches the header.

Current behavior in `website/src/scripts/init-game-replay.js`:
- Fetch the game export in the browser.
- Then append the YouTube link, blunder summary, old-analysis tag, critical error summary, season badge, and Season 0 banner into the header.
- The page initially renders as a generic shell with `Loading game data...` even though most of that header metadata is already known at build time for static replay pages.

Why this matters:
- Useful replay metadata is delayed until after client JS and fetch complete.
- The page does extra DOM mutation work for content Astro could have rendered declaratively.
- The replay header logic is harder to test because it is assembled imperatively after load.

Suggested fix:
1. Load replay metadata in the Astro route/component for static `/games/{id}` pages.
2. Render the replay header declaratively in Astro.
3. Leave the interactive snapshot viewer as the only client-side responsibility.

The result should be a replay page whose title, badges, summaries, and warnings are already present in the HTML response before the viewer boots.
